description: The price range of comparable Trailersite adverts for a trailer or caravan: the low, middle and high price and the adverts it came from, including ones that have sold. It narrows by make and model, then make, then size, then the whole section, and answers from the first that has enough adverts to be reliable. Give berths or bed_length_ft, not both; berths matches exactly and bed_length_ft within a tenth. When none has, it answers available false with no figure: say that Trailersite has too few comparable adverts to give a range, and never estimate one.

bed_length_ft.description: Bed length in feet, for trailers with a bed.

berths.description: Berths, for caravans and trailer tents.

category.description: Section: Touring caravans, Car transporters, Box trailers, Horse trailers, Motorbike trailers, Utility and camping trailers, Tipper trailers, Catering trailers, Boat and jet ski trailers, Livestock trailers, Plant trailers, Flatbed trailers, Trailer tents.

year.description: Narrows the make and model match to three years either side.
